LAW AND MOTION, 301, PLAINTIFF GLENRIDGE COOPERATIVE APARTMENTS' MOTION FOR SUMMARY JUDGMENT IS DENIED. PLAINTIFF HAS FAILED TO CARRY ITS BURDEN OF PROVIDING EVIDENCE ESTABLISHING ALL ELEMENTS OF ITS CASE. IN PARTICULAR, IT SEEKS DAMAGES BUT PROVIDES NO EVIDENCE AS TO THAT REMEDY, WHICH IS IN ANY EVENT, CONTROVERTED BY EVIDENCE CONCERNING HABITABILITY ISSUES. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. JUDGE: PETER J.
